posts.title: Cancer
posts.description: Since last October, I hadn’t been feeling great. A few months ago, I walked out of an oncology appointment having learned that I likely have early-stage cancer. You assume hearing that word from a doctor would stop everything on the spot, but for months, I didn’t understand it. I went to the appointments, listened to the explanations, and went right back to living the exact same way I had before.

posts.title: Intellectual click
posts.description: There is a kind of connection I don’t have a good name for, so I call it the intellectual click. You start talking to someone and within minutes you realize they think at your speed. You begin a sentence and they are already at the end of it. posts.title: Catchy 8-bit music
posts.description: Outside of work, I spend a fair amount of time messing around with music. One of my favorite formats is 8-bit game music: four tiny channels, no real reverb, no lush samples, just raw waveforms and strict polyphony limits.
